title: UPHL-BioNGS/Grandeur pipeline parameters
description: Grandeur is short-read de novo assembly pipeline with serotyping.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

fastas.description: directory with fasta files (not compatible with cloud resources)

fasta_list.description: A sample sheet for fasta files

reads.description: directory with paired-end illumina fastq files (not compatible with cloud resources)

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

sra_accessions.description: list of accessions to download from the ENA

genome_accessions.description: list of accessions to download from genomes

reference_genomes.description: list of genomes (in fasta format) for ANI references

min_core_genes.description: minimum number of genes in core genome alignment for iqtree2 (default is 500)

min_core_per.description: minimum percentage number of core genes in core genome alignment for iqtree2 (default is 0.5 or 50%)

minimum_reads.description: the minimum number of reads in a fastq file required to move to de novo alignment

exclude_top_hit.description: removes ANI top hit from msa

msa.description: toggles whether or not phylogenetic analysis will be run on samples

aligner.description: chooses core genome aligner (params.msa must be set to true)

annotator.description: chooses annotator (params.msa must be set to true)

skip_extras.description: turns off blobtools, kraken2, skani, mash, and report generation subworkflows

current_datasets.description: toggles whether or not genomes are downloaded from NCBI

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.
